questions.question: The NBPW, which can be considered as the most widespread Iron Age pottery, stands for _________.

• It is characterized by its glossy, shiny black surface.
 
• NBPW pottery is often associated with the period from around the 6th century BCE to the 2nd century BCE.
 
• It was widely used in northern India and has been found in significant archaeological sites like Pataliputra, Hastinapur, and Taxila.

• In India, the Iron Age roughly started around the 12th century BCE.
 
 
 
• **Archaeological Sites**
 
 
• **Pataliputra:** An ancient city in the Magadha region, which served as a capital for several Indian dynasties.
 
• **Hastinapur:** An ancient city mentioned in the Mahabharata, located in modern-day Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Taxila:** An important archaeological site in modern-day Pakistan, associated with ancient Indian history.
 
 
 
• **Pottery**
 
 
• Pottery is one of the most significant sources of information about ancient cultures.
 
• Different styles of pottery help archaeologists date and understand ancient civilizations.
 
 
 
• **Glossy Finish**
 
 
• The glossy finish of NBPW was achieved through a complex firing process.
 
• This finish made the pottery more durable and visually appealing.

questions.question: What was the major economic challenge addressed in the Third Five-Year Plan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**War-time expenditure and resource allocation**__.

__
 
• The Third Five-Year Plan (1961-1966) aimed to establish a self-reliant and self-generating economy in India.
 
• The major economic challenge addressed in the plan was the war-time expenditure and resource allocation due to the Indo-China War of 1962 and the Indo-Pak War of 1965.
 
• The plan had to be adjusted to accommodate increased defense spending and rehabilitation efforts.
 
• Despite these challenges, the plan also focused on agriculture, industry, and infrastructure development.
 
• The target growth rate was 5.6%, but the actual growth rate achieved was around 2.4%, partly due to the disruptions caused by the wars.

• **Indo-China War of 1962**

 
 
• The conflict between India and China took place between October and November 1962.
 
• It led to significant military expenditures and reallocation of resources in India.
 
• The war ended with a Chinese ceasefire on November 21, 1962.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Pak War of 1965**
 
 
• The war between India and Pakistan occurred from April to September 1965.
 
• It led to substantial defense spending and resource diversion from developmental activities.
 
• The war ended following a United Nations-mandated ceasefire.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Agriculture**
 
 
• The focus on agriculture during the Third Five-Year Plan included the introduction of high-yielding variety seeds.
 
• Significant investment was made in irrigation and fertilizer production to boost agricultural output.
 
 
 
• **Industrial Growth**
 
 
• The plan emphasized the development of heavy industries and the establishment of new industrial enterprises.
 
• However, the industrial growth was lower than expected due to resource diversion to defense needs.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development**
 
 
• Efforts were made to expand the transportation and communication networks.
 
• Investment in infrastructure was crucial for long-term economic growth despite immediate challenges.

questions.question: Part III of the Constitution of India stated about which of the following?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental Rights**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Part III of the Constitution of India deals with **Fundamental Rights**, which are enshrined from Article 12 to 35.
 
• These rights are considered essential for the all-around development of individuals and are applicable to all citizens of India.
 
• Fundamental Rights are justiciable, meaning they are enforceable by the courts, and individuals can approach the courts in case of any violation.
 
• They include rights such as the Right to Equality, Right to Freedom, Right against Exploitation, Right to Freedom of Religion, Cultural and Educational Rights, and Right to Constitutional Remedies.
 
• These rights act as a safeguard against any arbitrary actions of the state and ensure protection of individual liberties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Equality**

 
 
• It includes equality before the law, prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• It also includes equality of opportunity in matters of public employment and abolition of untouchability and titles.
 
 
 
• **Right to Freedom**
 
 
• It includes the freedom of speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and the right to practice any profession or occupation.
 
• These freedoms are subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by the state in the interest of sovereignty, integrity, and public order.
 
 
 
• **Right against Exploitation**
 
 
• This right prohibits all forms of forced labor, child labor, and human trafficking.
 
• It aims to protect individuals from exploitation and abuse.
 
 
 
• **Right to Freedom of Religion**
 
 
• It guarantees religious freedom to all citizens and ensures secularism in the country.

• It aimed to increase Indian control over domestic affairs while retaining British control over defense and foreign policy.

questions.question: Determine the largest four-digit number that is exactly divisible by 15, 25, 40, and 75.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The required number must be perfectly divisible by 15, 25, 40, and 75.

The LCM of 25 and 40 is 200, so any such common multiple must end with two zeros.

Among the given options (9600, 9960, 9975, and 9999), only 9600 ends with two zeros.

Also, 9600 is fully divisible by 15 and 75.

**∴ The correct answer is 9600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 15, 25, 40, and 75

**Concept Used:**

To find the largest number of a given number of digits divisible by a set of numbers, subtract the remainder when the largest possible number is divided by their LCM.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 25 = 5²

⇒ Prime factorization of 40 = 2³ × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 75 = 3 × 5²

⇒ LCM of (15, 25, 40, 75) = 2³ × 3 × 5²

⇒ LCM = 8 × 3 × 25 = 600

⇒ The largest four-digit number is 9999.

⇒ Now, divide 9999 by the LCM (600):

⇒ 9999 ÷ 600 = 16 with a remainder of 399.

⇒ Required number = Largest 4-digit number − Remainder

⇒ Required number = 9999 − 399 = 9600

**∴ The correct answer is 9600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The LCM of two or more numbers is the smallest number which is completely divisible by each of the given numbers without leaving a remainder.

Smallest n-digit Number Divisible by given numbers

To find the smallest n-digit number perfectly divisible by a set of numbers, use the formula: Required = Smallest n-digit Number + (LCM − Remainder).

Divisibility Rule of 25 and 40

A number is divisible by 25 if its last two digits are 00, 25, 50, or 75. A number is divisible by 40 if it is simultaneously divisible by both 5 and 8.
</p

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio of 4 : 9. If the mean proportional between them is 24, find the positive difference between the two numbers.

Let the two numbers be in the ratio parts 4x and 9x.

Mean proportional = √(4x × 9x) = √(36x²) = 6x.

Since the mean proportional is 24, we get 6x = 24 ⇒ x = 4.

Positive difference between the numbers = 9x − 4x = 5x.

Difference = 5 × 4 = 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

Ratio of the two numbers = 4 : 9

Mean proportional between the numbers = 24

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

 
 Number 1 = 4x

 Mean Prop = 6x = 24

 

 
 Difference = 5x = 20

**Calculations:**

Let the two numbers be 4x and 9x.

⇒ Mean proportional = √(4x × 9x)

⇒ √(36x²) = 24

⇒ 6x = 24

⇒ x = 24 ÷ 6

⇒ x = 4

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional of two quantities a and b is given by √(a × b). It represents the value x where a : x = x : b.

Third Proportional

The third proportional to numbers a and b is a value c such that a : b = b : c. It is calculated using the formula c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

The fourth proportional to numbers a, b, and c is a value d such that a : b = c : d. It is computed as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

When the sum of two successive discounts is constant, the effective discount is maximized when their numerical difference is maximum.

Difference for each scheme: I = 0%, II = 10%, III = 20%, IV = 30%.

Scheme IV has the maximum difference (35% − 5% = 30%), hence it provides the maximum effective discount.

 Effective Discount Comparison

Successive Discounts

questions.question: The HCF of two numbers is 11 and their sum is 132. If both the numbers are greater than 42, then the difference between the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the numbers be 11x and 11y (where x, y are co-prime).

Sum = 11(x + y) = 132 ⇒ x + y = 12

Valid co-prime pairs for sum 12 are (1, 11) and (5, 7).

For (5, 7), the numbers are 55 and 77 (since both must be > 42).

Difference = 77 − 55 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF of the two numbers = 11

Sum of the two numbers = 132

Condition: Both numbers are greater than 42

**Formula Used:**

Any two numbers can be written as (HCF × a) and (HCF × b), where a and b are co-prime integers.

 Sum = 132 | HCF = 11
 
 Number 1
 
 11 × 5 = 55
 
 Number 2
 
 11 × 7 = 77
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 

 Diff = 22

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the two numbers be 11a and 11b, where a and b are co-prime.

⇒ Sum of the numbers = 11a + 11b = 132

⇒ 11(a + b) = 132

⇒ a + b = 132 ÷ 11 = 12

⇒ The possible integer pairs of (a, b) whose sum is 12 are: (1, 11), (2, 10), (3, 9), (4, 8), (5, 7), and (6, 6).

⇒ Since a and b must be co-prime (having no common factor other than 1), the valid pairs are (1, 11) and (5, 7).

⇒ Case 1: If a = 1 and b = 11 ⇒ The numbers are (11 × 1) = 11 and (11 × 11) = 121. (Rejected because 11 is not greater than 42).

⇒ Case 2: If a = 5 and b = 7 ⇒ The numbers are (11 × 5) = 55 and (11 × 7) = 77. (Accepted because both 55 and 77 are greater than 42).

⇒ The difference between the two numbers = 77 − 55 = 22.

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is exactly 1. When dividing two numbers by their HCF, the resulting quotients must always be co-prime.

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two numbers, the product of their HCF and LCM is strictly equal to the product of the numbers themselves: HCF × LCM = Number₁ × Number₂.

LCM Formula from Ratios

If two numbers are in the ratio a : b (where a and b are co-prime), their Least Common Multiple (LCM) is calculated directly as HCF × a × b.
